#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int calc(int a, int b, int l, int r) {
    int period = a + b;
    if (r - l + 1 > 2 * period) {
        if (a <= b) return a + 1;
        return 2 * a - b;
    }
    vector<int> value(3 * period + 2, 0); // 1-indexed
    int last = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
        value[i] = i;
        last = i;
    }
    for (int i = a + 1; i <= period; i++) {
        value[i] = last;
    }
    for (int i = period + 1; i <= period + a; i++) {
        int candidate = 1;
        while (true) {
            bool found = false;
            for (int j = b + 1; j <= i - 1; j++) {
                if (value[j] == candidate) {
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!found) break;
            candidate++;
        }
        value[i] = candidate;
        last = candidate;
    }
    for (int i = period + a + 1; i <= 2 * period; i++) {
        value[i] = last;
    }
    for (int i = 2 * period + 1; i <= 3 * period; i++) {
        value[i] = value[i - period];
    }
    vector<bool> hit(25, false);
    int start = l % period;
    if (start == 0) start = period;
    int finish = r - l + start;
    if (finish < start) finish += period;
    for (int i = start; i <= finish; i++) {
        hit[value[i]] = true;
    }
    int answer = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 24; i++) {
        if (hit[i]) answer++;
    }
    return answer;
}

int main() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;
    cout << calc(a, b, l, r) << endl;
    return 0;
}
